privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Beerolog collects, why we process it, and which third parties help us run the service.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your account identifier, and your email and display name if your sign-in provider shares them; your baseline taste profile (taste dials, flavor family, novelty affinity); and your beer ratings and optional notes.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: To build your taste persona and generate beer recommendations. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Beerolog data vs. authentication data
sections.body: Sign-in and session data are held by our authentication provider, Clerk. The data listed above is stored in Beerolog's own database.

sections.heading: Ephemeral session intent
sections.body: The vibe, ABV range, and free text you enter for a recommendation are processed for that request only and are not stored as standalone records.

sections.heading: Taste embedding
sections.body: We derive an internal similarity vector from your ratings for matching. It is disclosed here but is not human-readable and is not included in data exports.

sections.heading: Sub-processors
sections.body: Clerk (authentication), our hosting provider, our database provider, and OpenAI (model inference). Prompts sent for inference are not logged beyond our observability rules.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can export or permanently delete the data Beerolog stores about you from your account settings. Authentication data may also be managed through Clerk.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Email privacy@beerolog.example to ask about your data. (Contact address pending launch.)

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Beerolog you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Age requirement
sections.body: Beerolog presents information about alcoholic beverages and is intended only for users of legal drinking age in their location.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use Beerolog for personal, lawful purposes. Do not attempt to disrupt or abuse the service.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: Recommendations are provided for guidance only, without warranty. Drink responsibly.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms; material changes will be reflected on this page.

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.intro: Beerolog uses a small number of cookies. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Essential cookies
sections.body: age_verified records that you confirmed you are of legal drinking age, so the age gate is not shown on every visit. It is required to access alcohol-related content and cannot be turned off while you use the site.

sections.heading: Functional cookies
sections.body: lang remembers your language preference (Hebrew or English). It is not used for tracking.

sections.heading: Non-essential cookies
sections.body: We do not set analytics or marketing cookies. If that ever changes, they will not be activated without your explicit opt-in.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Beerolog is committed to making its supported experience accessible to everyone.

sections.heading: Conformance target
sections.body: We aim to meet Israeli Standard SI 5568, which adopts WCAG 2.0 Level AA, across the supported sign-in, onboarding, and recommendation flows.

sections.heading: Known gaps
sections.body: Our third-party sign-in screens are provided by Clerk and may not fully meet our target; we track their accessibility and will update this statement as gaps are closed. Remediation timeline: pending launch.

sections.heading: Accessibility coordinator
sections.body: Coordinator name and role: pending assignment. Contact: accessibility@beerolog.example.

sections.heading: Feedback
sections.body: If you encounter a barrier, contact our accessibility coordinator and we will work to resolve it.
